title: Add Billing context to Encounter resource
description:
Extend the Aidbox Encounter resource with a billing context field linking to the active billing case. Update the FHIR profile and adjust search parameter indexing.

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Encounter records include billing context field | integ | Aidbox API call verifies field presence |
| 2 | Search by billing context returns correct Encounters | integ | adapter/tests/encounter-billing.test.ts |
acceptance_criteria:
- New Encounter records include a billing context reference field
- Search by billing context returns correct results
- Existing Encounter records are unaffected

metadata.intent: Enable billing context attribution on Encounter resources. Scope IN: Aidbox profile update, search index. Scope OUT: UI changes, migration of existing records.
